title: Fair only
text: Fair only. After using this awhile, I am really disappointed in it's temp control. Instead of shutting itself off when it reached the desired temp, it just keeps running on "fan" mode (no matter what settings you use). The issue is cost. It does not need to run while the room is at ideal temp. It's a waste of resources!
